description: Udtræden af spildevandsforsyning mulig - PlanDK is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Plan- og Landdistriktsstyrelsen. Wastewater plans are used in NOVANA, Water plans - including in municipal action plans. The Ministry of the Environment is responsible for waste water planning, while the municipalities are administrative authorities. Coverage: Plan- og Landdistriktsstyrelsen. The portal shows the English title as "Exit of wastewater supply possible - PlanDK" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Plan- og Landdistriktsstyrelsen. Its keywords include Spildevand, Planlægning. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PNG, GML, HTML. The listing shows 2025-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
